plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Paramedic A.S. Degree (Full Time, Spring Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 16, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7426/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: local AA/AS, Start Term: Spring. Total Units 67 = 16+12.5+17.5+12+9 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Students in majors with 45 units or more of required coursework are exempt from the Area L7 general education requirement, so it is not included in this map; changing majors may require completing the L7 requirement. This degree can be completed using either the local AA/AS GE pattern or the Cal-GETC transfer GE pattern; see a counselor. Scheduling: PMED 114 and 115 are offered sequentially in the spring; PMED 121 is offered in the summer; PMED 131 is offered in the fall. PROGRAM ELIGIBILITY AND SELECTION: This program has eligibility requirements and a selection process; detailed information about the program and pre-enrollment applications and selection criteria may be found in the college catalog and on the college website. Students must have a high school diploma or equivalent to enter the program. To enroll, students must have a current EMT-Basic certification and approximately one year of verified EMS experience or a minimum of 280 verifiable EMS patient encounters acting as a team lead. This degree prepares students for licensure as paramedics, working for a fire department, rescue squad, private provider, industry, clinic, or hospital. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H.
